readout_control.meaning: Unknown symmetric, unscaled readout flip; e_c=c+(1-2c)r/4, distinct from the Eve-only target r/4.

acquisitions.single: Multinomial(T;1/8,1/8,1/8,1/8,1/2); retain error/total counts in each bit-and-basis stratum. Subset, basis-average, and full estimators reuse these same counts.

scaled.design: Previously fixed cap-4 design, transferred unchanged to every circuit; not separately optimized by circuit.
scaled.sampling: Independent Binomial(Tj,1/2) sifted counts and aggregate errors at each setting.

estimation.full: Binomial transition likelihood with independently unknown pA,pB,r; B+ single setting is nonidentifiable and no arbitrary point-estimator error is reported.
estimation.basis: Equal-device binomial likelihood on the two basis totals; B+ single setting is nonidentifiable.
estimation.subset: PRIMARY rectilinear-zero error fraction, Wilson 95% interval; no device noise parameter fit.
estimation.scaled: Binomial likelihood on four aggregate rates with independently unknown pA,pB,r.
estimation.profile: Nominal 95% profile-likelihood sets for r/4, cutoff chi2_1(.95)=3.841458820694124. Physical bounds retained; empirical coverage measured rather than assumed exact at boundaries.
estimation.numerics: For fixed r and pA, convex optimization in pB; profile pA on a 65-point grid, refine all local minima and endpoint intervals. Profile r on 41 points, refine minima and locate likelihood-ratio crossings. Validate against independent optimizers and denser profiles.

retained_data_analysis: Refit all five existing held-out four-setting cohorts by binomial likelihood and report profile intervals, matrix conditioning, nuisance versus residual precision, width quantiles and boundary-stratified coverage. These are reanalyses, not new acquisitions.
scope: Circuit-specific diagnostics, no new reconciliation development or competitive-code benchmark. Design and target fixed before new acquisitions.
